title: Cyber - Digital Trust & Online Protection - Product Compliance - L45
description:
**Data Protection - Product Compliance - Senior Consultant**

Deloitte's Regulatory, Risk & Forensic practice helps clients turn evolving regulatory and risk requirements into practical action. Our Product Compliance practice supports technology, media, and telecommunications organizations in embedding compliance across the product lifecycle, from strategy and design through launch, monitoring, and incident response, including for artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled and agentic products. Join a team that combines data, AI, emerging technology, and industry insight to help clients navigate complexity and create value.

**Work you'll do**

As a Security Engineer III on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

* Support product compliance program design and transformation, including operating models, product lifecycle processes, governance, compliance-by-design, automation, testing, and issue remediation.
* Translate regulatory developments affecting software, digital platforms, and AI-enabled products into product requirements, risk taxonomies, control architectures, and policies.
* Assess product processes, data flows, and controls, including identity, access, data use, and third-party dependencies, to support risk assessments and compliance-by-design practices.
* Execute control testing, launch-readiness reviews, red-teaming, release regression testing, key risk and control indicator monitoring, incident exercises, and evidence management for requests for information (RFIs) and audits.
* Support AI and agentic product compliance, data, identity, and access governance, age assurance, youth-by-design, and third-party risk; manage workstreams and contribute to client deliverables, proposals, and thought leadership.

**The team**

Deloitte's Data and Digital Trust practice helps clients use data responsibly while safeguarding privacy, security, and digital trust. We advise, implement, and operate solutions across privacy governance and compliance, data protection and compliance, digital trust and online protection, risk and controls enablement, and technology implementation. Our teams help organizations respond to changing regulations, consumer expectations, and technology developments while advancing sustainable digital transformation.

**Location: Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Law, Business Management, or Public Policy
* 4+ years of experience in technology, media, and telecommunications or consulting in product compliance program design, product risk assessments, compliance-by-design, trust and safety, regulatory implementation, product compliance testing and validation, compliance automation, regulatory readiness, or data analysis.
* Experience supporting client engagements or project workstreams in a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment.

Preferred:

* Experience with product regulations and frameworks, including the Digital Markets Act, Digital Services Act, Cyber Resilience Act, European Union Data Act, European Union Artificial Intelligence Act, United Kingdom Online Safety Act, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), age-appropriate design and youth online safety laws, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework, or International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 42001.
* Experience with regulatory requirements analysis, product applicability mapping, and regulatory controls testing.
* Experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and compliance automation tools, including ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management (IRM), Archer, or policy-as-code integrations in continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
* Experience supporting product compliance, trust and safety, or regulatory risk functions in a technology, media, and telecommunications company or other regulated industry, including risk assessments, reporting, controls, testing, or data analytics.
* Experience with artificial intelligence (AI) governance, age assurance and youth safety, or product data, identity, and access governance for digital products.
* Experience partnering with product, engineering, legal, and policy teams to embed compliance requirements in product design, user stories, and release processes; supporting proposal development, client presentations, or business development activities; or holding a Master of Business Administration, Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager, Certified Information Privacy Professional, AI Governance Professional, Certified Information Systems Auditor, Project Management Professional, or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control designation.

**DT&P -** #Cyber\_Digital Trust & Privacy

#CA-TD

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior Professional, Global Mobility & Compliance
description:
**About Us:**

  
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  
  

**Job Description:**

**Job Description**

**Senior Professional, Global Mobility and Compliance**

**Reports To:** Director, People
  
**Location:** Chennai, India
  
**Function:** People Team, BW India GCC

  

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the *St. Louis Business Journal* list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

**Our culture is built on:**

· **Ownership –** Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

· **Flexibility –** A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.

· **Empowerment –** Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.

· **Learning and Growth –** Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**  
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

**Role Overview**

This role is responsible for ensuring effective governance, compliance and administration across immigration, team member relations, workplace policy compliance, employment documentation, POSH processes and related People compliance activities within the GCC.

The role serves as a subject matter expert and advisor to leaders, People partners and team members on team member relations matters, policy interpretation, immigration requirements and employment-related compliance considerations. The role partners closely with People, Legal, business leaders and external service providers to ensure compliance with applicable laws, company policies and established People processes while maintaining a positive team member experience.

The position will help strengthen governance, consistency and risk management across People practices while supporting the continued growth of the GCC.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Mobility**

* Manage end-to-end immigration processes for GCC team members requiring work authorization, visas and mobility support.
* Partner with business leaders, Talent Acquisition and People partners on mobility requirements and immigration planning.
* Coordinate with external immigration law firms and service providers.
* Monitor immigration timelines, documentation requirements and compliance obligations.
* Manage immigration escalations, Requests for Evidence, visa delays and related issues.
* Maintain immigration policies, documentation standards and governance processes.
* Ensure accurate records and reporting related to immigration programs.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and enhanced team member experience.

**Team member Relations**

* Support the resolution of grievances, team member complaints and workplace conflicts through established processes.
* Partner with leaders and People team members on disciplinary matters, conduct concerns and team member counselling situations.
* Assist in fact-finding, documentation and investigations relating to team member concerns.
* Support fairness, consistency and procedural compliance in team member relations matters.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality and documentation standards.

**Policy Compliance & Governance**

* Support the implementation, interpretation and consistent application of People policies.
* Provide guidance to leaders and team members regarding policy-related questions.
* Review policy exceptions and support appropriate escalation and decision-making.
* Assist in the development, review and maintenance of People policies, procedures and guidelines.
* Support governance reviews to ensure People practices remain aligned with organizational requirements.
* Identify compliance risks and recommend corrective actions where required.

**Employment Law & People Compliance**

* Partner with People and Legal stakeholders on employment-related matters.
* Support employment documentation including contracts, letters, notices and related records.
* Provide guidance regarding team member separations, notice periods, absconding situations and related documentation.
* Assist with interpretation of employment requirements and workplace obligations.
* Support compliance reviews and documentation relating to employment practices.
* Monitor regulatory developments relevant to People practices and escalate implications as required.

**POSH Compliance**

* Support ongoing compliance with Prevention of Sexual Harassment requirements.
* Partner with Internal Committees on documentation, investigations and case administration.
* Ensure procedural compliance and documentation standards are maintained.
* Support awareness initiatives and policy communication.
* Assist with statutory reporting and record maintenance as required.

**Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with immigration service providers, law firms and other external partners.
* Monitor vendor performance, responsiveness and service quality.
* Support vendor governance and periodic review processes.

**Training & Communication**

* Develop manager and team member awareness regarding People policies and compliance requirements.
* Support communications related to policy updates and compliance initiatives.
* Deliver workshops or awareness sessions on immigration, policy compliance and workplace conduct topics as required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Law (B.L./LL.B.) or equivalent.
* Postgraduate qualification in HR, Employment Law or related field preferred.
* Qualified Advocate preferred.
POSH certification desirable.  

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
  + Immigration and Global Mobility
  + Team member Relations
  + Employment Compliance
  + HR Policy Governance
  + Employment Law Advisory
  + Workplace Investigations
  + POSH Administration
* Experience working with global stakeholders and external law firms preferred.
Experience within a multinational organization or GCC environment strongly preferred.  

**Key Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* Immigration and Mobility Administration
* Team member Relations
* Policy Interpretation and Governance
* Employment Documentation
* POSH Processes
* Workplace Investigations
* Risk Assessment and Documentation
* Regulatory Compliance
* Vendor Management
* Case Management

**Behavioural Skills**

* Sound judgement
* Problem solving
* Attention to detail
* Managing confidential information
* Stakeholder management
* Influencing and communication
* Conflict resolution
* Process improvement
Organizational agility  

To understand more about our people-first philosophy, you may like to watch this short video by our CEO, **Mr. Bob Chapman** , on *Truly Human Leadership* : Watch the video

  
  

*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

  
  

**Company:**

BW Corporate GCC

title: Legal Officer- Civil
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Legal Officer will support the legal department in handling various civil matters, with a focus on land litigations, land registrations, and related civil cases. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of civil law and excellent analytical skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft, review, and manage legal documents related to:
* Land registrations and transfer of property ownership
* Legal notices and demand letters related to land disputes
* Pleadings (e.g., complaints, answers, motions) in land litigation cases
* Affidavits and declarations pertinent to land matters
* Settlement agreements in land-related disputes
* Court filings and other documentation for land litigations
* Conduct legal research on land laws, property rights, and relevant regulations.
* Assist in litigation processes, including the preparation of case files, evidence collection, and witness statements for land disputes.
* Support the legal team in dispute resolution and negotiations, particularly in cases involving land ownership and boundary disputes.
* Maintain and organize legal files and documentation related to land registrations and litigations.
* Monitor changes in legislation and regulations affecting land use and registration processes.
* Liaise with external counsel, regulatory bodies, and land registration authorities as necessary.
* Assist in the development and implementation of legal policies and procedures related to land matters.
* Provide administrative support to senior legal staff as required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB) or equivalent.
* Minimum of 5 years experience in a legal role with a focus on land litigations and registrations.
* Strong understanding of civil litigation processes, land laws, and legal documentation.
* Familiarity with property registration procedures and regulations.
* Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.
* Proficient in legal software and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in real estate law, property law, and regulatory compliance.
* Immediate joiners are highly preferable.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Opportunities for professional development and training.
* Flexible work environment and work-life balance initiatives.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and growth.
* A supportive and collaborative work environment.

**Location:**

Vgp Square, 6, Dharmaraja Koil St, Periyapet,

Saidapet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600 015.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter outlining their qualifications and experience to hr@vgphousing.com

* Legal research: 1 year (Required)

title: Associate Director, Employment Counsel
description:
**Job Family****:**

Legal Counsel (India)

**Travel Required****:**

Up to 10%

**Clearance Required****:**

None

**What You Will Do****:**  
Serve as the primary legal advisor on employment law matters affecting the Company's operations in India, providing practical, risk-based guidance to Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, business leaders, and other stakeholders.

* Monitor, analyze, and communicate developments in Indian labor and employment laws, regulations, and court decisions, including emerging requirements under the Labour Codes and other employment-related legislation.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and maintain employment-related agreements and documents, including offer letters, employment agreements, restrictive covenant agreements, separation documents, contractor agreements, and employment policies.
* Advise on employee lifecycle matters, including hiring, performance management, disciplinary actions, accommodations, investigations, leaves of absence, employee relations issues, and terminations.
* Partner with HR and business leaders to support workforce initiatives, organizational changes, restructurings, policy implementation, and compliance programs.
* Conduct legal research and provide clear, actionable recommendations on complex or novel employment law issues.
* Manage relationships with external counsel and coordinate legal advice on specialized employment, labor, compliance, and litigation matters.
* Support employment-related disputes, government inquiries, audits, investigations, and litigation by gathering facts, assessing risk, and developing legal strategy.
* Develop and deliver training and guidance to HR professionals and business leaders on employment law obligations and best practices.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of policies, processes, templates, and controls designed to promote legal compliance and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with Legal, Ethics & Compliance, Privacy, and other corporate functions on matters involving workplace compliance, investigations, data protection, and regulatory requirements.  
    
  **What You Will Need****:**
* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) and qualification to practice law in India; additional legal credentials or certifications are a plus.
* 15+ years of experience practicing employment and labor law, preferably with a leading law firm, multinational corporation, or a combination of both.
* Deep knowledge of Indian employment and labor laws, including employee relations, disciplinary processes, terminations, wages and benefits, social security requirements, workplace investigations, and workplace harassment obligations.
* Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating employment-related agreements, policies, and other legal documents.
* Demonstrated ability to identify legal risks and provide practical, business-oriented solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong legal research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience advising senior business leaders, HR professionals, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex legal concepts to non-legal audiences.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different geographies, functions, and levels of the organization.  
* **What Would Be Nice To Have****:**
* Experience supporting multinational organizations with global or regional employment law matters.
* Familiarity with the implementation and ongoing developments relating to India's Labour Codes and other evolving employment law reforms.
* Experience conducting internal investigations and advising on employee misconduct, whistleblower, ethics, or workplace concerns.
* Exposure to corporate compliance programs, including policy development, training, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance initiatives.
* Experience managing employment litigation, labor disputes, government inspections, or regulatory inquiries.
* Knowledge of data privacy requirements affecting the employment relationship, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP).
* Experience supporting cross-border employment issues, workforce transitions, contingent worker programs, or employment aspects of mergers, acquisitions, and reorganizations.
* In-house legal experience within a professional services, consulting, technology, or multinational corporate environment.
* Experience developing and delivering training programs for HR and business leadership teams.

title: Legal Manager ( Real Estate ) 8-10 years
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – LEGAL MANAGER ( REAL ESTATE)

**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Development  
**Department:** Legal  
**Designation:** Legal Manager

**Experience:** 08-10 years  
**Salary Range:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month  
**Location:** Chennai

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Legal Manager to handle legal documentation, property registration, land-related legal matters, and statutory approvals for our real estate projects. The candidate should have strong knowledge of property laws, excellent drafting skills, and the ability to maintain a good professional rapport with government officials and registration authorities.

Key Responsibilities1. Legal Document Drafting

* Draft, review, and finalize sale agreements, construction agreements, allocation agreements, joint venture agreements, and other property-related legal documents.
